title: Hedge legs marked when a shape is loaded or detected (G-15-8)

ours: Built in row 20, commit 463dca78 (W-148): the Hedge MARK on a leg comes only from the server reply; pinned by frontend/tests/leg-edit.test.js: AC-8/AC-9 (attack 4): name and Hedge marks come only from the reply. The Hedge CONTROL that moves those legs is not built: it is REQ-078, a later row.
